guidance: see code output for additional algorithm citations

name: read_fname
description: Resolved input filename, including its extension.
guidance: Read from read_path; defaults to the parameter filename stem when omitted.

name: read_path
description: Resolved directory from which input files are read.
guidance: Defaults to the directory holding the parameter file.

name: write_fname
description: Resolved output filename prefix (no path or extension).
guidance: Defaults to the stem of read_fname when omitted.

name: write_path
description: Resolved directory to which output files are written.
